target.statement: SBOC-R achieves success rate S = 63.5% over all 52 test functions (and SBOC-K 65.4%), i.e. the headline success-rate table cell for the proposed algorithm
target.dataset: 52 analytical test functions (Table 2), N=2..10, Kmax=100N, 10 random runs each

compute.basis: No code released; the full SBOC algorithm (Sobol init, RBF/KRG surrogate with hyperparameter selection, multi-start SQP minimization, elbow-method k-means, exploration/exploitation point rules) must be reimplemented from the paper, then run 10x on 52 functions with Kmax=100N evaluations; Table 8 shows per-run surrogate minimization alone takes tens of seconds to minutes, so the full protocol is many CPU-hours.

blockers: No code or supplementary implementation linked in the paper
Full protocol requires reimplementing SBOC-R and SBOC-K plus 16 benchmark algorithms to reproduce the comparison
Table 8 wall-clock times imply the full 52-function x 10-run protocol is many CPU-hours even for SBOC alone
title: Surrogate-based Optimization via Clustering for Box-Constrained Problems
